$comment: How a ${VAR} in a knowledge base's config resolves, and which variables a template names — shared by three consumers: the TypeScript config loader (packages/core, toml-loader.ts resolveEnvVars), the Go launcher's resolver (apps/launcher, gatewaydoc.go resolveRefs, which resolves the gateway's configuration document), and the launcher's extractor (config.go placeholderRefs), which decides what start demands (required: ${NAME}) and what it forwards when set (optional: ${NAME:-default}). The resolvers run every case's result or error; the extractor runs every case's references. A change to the rule changes this table first.

cases.why: a set variable replaces its reference
text without a reference is itself
every reference in a value is resolved
an unset variable with a default takes the default
a set variable wins over its default
a variable set to the empty string is set
a name referenced both with and without a default is required
an unset variable with no default refuses, naming it
